mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend (user_id, friend_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{friendId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM friend WHERE (user_id = #{userIdA} AND friend_id = #{userIdB}) OR (user_id = #{userIdB} AND friend_id = #{userIdA})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friend WHERE user_id = #{userIdA} AND friend_id = #{userIdB}
SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM friend f INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.friend_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 ORDER BY u.id
SELECT friend_id FROM friend WHERE user_id = #{userId}
